watch.summary: The streamer passionately hypes up 100T's dominant performance against NRG during a Valorant match broadcast.

Creator laughs at player face cams and replay footage.
Creator slams his desk shouting 'This is Champions caliber!'
Creator quietly watches the next round unfold in admiration.
